title: Munhu Akadzingwa Mubindu
intro: Chisikwa chisinganzwisisike chaimbogara munzvimbo dzepamusoro dzezvisikwa, chiri pedyo naMwari kupfuura zvaifungwa nevakawanda. Asi kuzvikudza kwakadzika midzi, uye chiito chimwe chete chekusateerera chakachinja mararamiro ehupenyu. Zvino, chisikwa ichi chinodzungaira semuvengi akapika, chichitaura makuhwa uye chichiita manomano kusvika zuva rakavimbiswa rasvika. Unogona here kuburitsa pachena kuti uyu akawira pasi?
clues: Ndaimbova mumwe weavo vaiva pedyo nekuvapo kwaMwari, vakasimudzirwa pamusoro pezvakawanda zvakasikwa.
Ndakasikwa kubva muchinhu chinopisa, kwete kubva muvhu kana ivhu.
Pandakarayirwa kuti ndikotamire chisikwa chitsva, ndakaramba — ndichitungamirirwa nezvandaitenda kuti ndizvo zvandaiva pamusoro pazvo.
Ndakadzingwa ndikatukwa, asi pakupedzisira ndakazorodzwa kusvika panguva yakatarwa inozivikanwa.
Ndakapika kuti ndaizotsausa vazhinji vangu, ndichiswedera kuvana vaAdhamu kubva kumativi ese.
Ndiri muvengi wevanhu vose, anotaurwa pachena, anogara achironga uye achizevezera kusvika pakuguma kwakatarwa.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all (15:39)
